Demo health

Reaching a page and playing it are separate checks. Old checks are marked stale; they do not become fresh when you visit.

Your privacy choices

Optional anonymous interaction counts help improve discovery. No search text, email, code or private project details are sent. Counts expire after 30 days. Your local collection works with this turned off.

Curator operations

Requires a curator session. Network checks run through the local operations CLI.
